reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. Our new native sparse cellular automata (CA) keeps ponds affordable and allows for smoother terrain manipulation without freezing the frame. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Major Improvements to Water Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to share that our latest update includes significant enhancements to water mechanics! With native sparse CA, water now responds more accurately to terrain changes without causing frame drops. Learn all about these improvements and how they will affect your gameplay in our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
